title: Apple completes deal to buy Shazam | Kitco News
text:
Apple completes deal to buy Shazam Reuters Monday September 24, 2018 12:44
Kitco News
Share this article:
(Reuters) - Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) has completed the acquisition of music discovery app Shazam, it said on Monday, weeks after the European Union approved the deal.
The deal, announced in December last year, is expected to help the iPhone maker better compete with Spotify ( SPOT.N ), the industry leader in music streaming services.
